page_title: NIC 1-2 NAN | Nice v Nantes 31/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+8' A quickly taken corner by Nantes.
90+7' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+6' We are about to witness a substitution. Nathan Zeze (Nantes) is replacing Douglas Augusto.
90+5' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+4' The free kick is whipped into the box and finds Antoine Mendy (Nice), who plants a header just wide of the right post from close range.
90+2' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) takes the corner which is cleared.
90+1' Marcus Coco (Nantes) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) took the corner.
88' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

88' Antoine Mendy (Nice) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Alban Lafont was alert and made a comfortable save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Nice are going to take it.
87' Antoine Kombouare prepares a substitution. Florent Mollet is replaced by Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes).
87' Mostafa Mohamed will be replaced by Marcus Coco (Nantes).
86' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
85' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Alban Lafont has no trouble gathering it.
84' Florent Mollet (Nantes) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
84' It is time for a substitution. Aliou Balde (Nice) is on for Jordan Lotomba.
82' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
82' Nice work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

81' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
79' Antoine Kombouare has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tino Kadewere (Nantes) replacing Matthis Abline.
78' Matthis Abline (Nantes) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gaetan Laborde (Nice) comes onto the pitch for Jeremie Boga.
76' 1 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Marcin Bulka no chance!
76' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
75' Antoine Mendy (Nice) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Bastien Dechepy saw the whole situation. It's a penalty for Nantes!
74' The game is interrupted now, Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
73' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
72' 1 - 1 GOAL! Terem Moffi (Nice) takes a real chance, but his penalty strike right into the middle of the net fools Alban Lafont in goal.
71' Terem Moffi (Nice) is going to take the penalty!
70' Referee Bastien Dechepy awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
69' There's a break in play and referee Bastien Dechepy must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Nice using VAR. This could be interesting!

68' Eray Comert (Nantes) was too forceful with his tackle and Bastien Dechepy interrupted the game to signal a free kick. PENALTY! One of the players from Nice is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
66' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Marcin Bulka.
65' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
64' Florent Mollet (Nantes) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
61' Antoine Mendy (Nice) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
60' That's the end of the game for Tom Louchet, who is replaced by Antoine Mendy (Nice).
60' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a change. Melvin Bard (Nice) replaces Romain Perraud.
60' That will be all from Mohamed-Ali Cho who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Evann Guessand (Nice).
58' This is a yellow card! Jordan Lotomba (Nice) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
58' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
58' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
57' Tom Louchet (Nice) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
56' The ball goes out for a corner. Nice can continue in their attacking effort.
55' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle as Jordan Lotomba (Nice) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
53' Nantes couldn't find the way to score from a close-range free kick as Marcin Bulka (Nice) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
52' Eray Comert (Nantes) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
52' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
51' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
48' The free kick from long range, taken by Nice, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
47' Nantes are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Jeremie Boga (Nice), but the defence gets it clear.
44' Jeremie Boga (Nice) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
42' The resulting free kick from Douglas Augusto (Nantes) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
40' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
38' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
36' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Tom Louchet (Nice), but Alban Lafont is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
35' Nice are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
34' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
32' A player from Nice brings down an opponent and commits a foul. It's a free kick to Nantes in a dangerous position.
30' The free kick from long range, taken by Nantes, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Matthis Abline (Nantes) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
25' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
24' The ball is out of play. Nice will have a throw-in.
19' 0 - 1 Matthis Abline (Nantes) heads the ball inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.

19' Matthis Abline (Nantes) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Marcin Bulka sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.
16' The referee points to the corner flag and Nice will take a corner.

15' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) tries his luck with a shot from long range, but his effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
14' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Nantes was in an offside position.
13' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
11' Nantes fail to score from a corner as Marcin Bulka (Nice) leaps to collect the ball.

11' Matthis Abline (Nantes) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nantes.
9' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
8' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
6' Dangerous play by Dante (Nice). Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Nantes, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
4' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
3' Matthis Abline (Nantes) picks up a long through ball, but Marcin Bulka deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
2' Neat passing move from Nantes in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The match has just started.
Bastien Dechepy got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
